title: Where did the extra heat come from?
hook: One unit of electricity delivers three units of heat indoors.

knows: the quantities named in the question
doesNotKnow: The pump moves heat from outside and adds the energy it consumes: 2 kWh from outside plus 1 kWh of electricity makes 3 kWh delivered indoors.

misconception: The alternative answers in the prediction appear plausible without the stated physical model.
objective: The pump moves heat from outside and adds the energy it consumes: 2 kWh from outside plus 1 kWh of electricity makes 3 kWh delivered indoors.

claims.text: The pump moves heat from outside and adds the energy it consumes: 2 kWh from outside plus 1 kWh of electricity makes 3 kWh delivered indoors. Illustrative constant coefficient of performance of 3. Actual performance varies with operating conditions.
claims.source: Energy balance Q_hot = Q_cold + W; illustrative heating COP Q_hot/W = 3.

recall.question: A heat pump uses 2 kWh of electricity and delivers 8 kWh indoors. How much heat did it take from outside?
recall.why: 8 − 2 = 6 kWh comes from outside in this idealized energy balance.
